What this result means

This is a conditional damage calculation before shield, mitigation, HP caps and triggered HP changes. It is not a prediction of final HP lost.

Arachne’s max Eternal Weave contributes 72 Realm Mastery before mastery multipliers. Enter the final stat with the equipped Wheel included. Its amplification passive requires Arachne’s own pursuits, which this sequence does not include.

Prism and Beacon add within the same damage multiplier. Mouchette’s pursuits receive Prism but do not activate the before-card Beacon trigger.
